actors.name: Leila
actors.private_context: Leila is the founder. She is offering 0.3% equity to a prospective advisor who has asked for 1%. She knows her co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% is too rich. She wants to reach an agreement within a month.

actors.name: Advisor
actors.private_context: The advisor is a retired logistics executive who has already made two useful introductions. He has asked for 1% equity. He is considering the offer of 0.3% and may negotiate.

actors.name: Co-founder
actors.private_context: The co-founder thinks anything above 0.5% equity for the advisor is too rich. They have influence over Leila's decisions.

shared_context: The company's standard advisor template vests over two years. Leila and the advisor are in discussions about equity terms. The advisor has already made two useful introductions. The hard cutoff for an agreement is 2026-10-10T10:00:00-07:00.

starting_events.description: Leila and the advisor are at an impasse: Leila offers 0.3% equity, the advisor wants 1%. No agreement has been reached yet.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that an advisor agreement was executed between Leila and the advisor before 2026-10-10T10:00:00-07:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
